A key MAY appear under more than one skill: a rule about writing .bat files
matters both to the skill that WRITES them and the one that RUNS them.
Duplication is safe here and only here, because every block is REGENERATED
from cowork-lessons.md. Hand-copied rules drift; generated ones cannot.
prefix - any Pattern-Key starting with this string
A key routed nowhere stays in the general lessons file, which remains the
authoritative home for every entry. Nothing here DELETES a lesson - the
entry keeps its Pattern-Key, its evidence and its history, and gains a
Promoted-to pointer saying which skill now carries the rule.
PUBLISHED COPY: routes for skills withheld from this repository (workflow conversion, deck generation) were removed so `skill_lessons.py --check` opens only files that exist here.
